% A memoir document with its own heading fonts: a part and a chapter whose
% title font is not bold, under a bold label, a section in
% \setsecheadstyle's italic at the text size, and a run-in paragraph in
% \setparaheadstyle's italic. The part's title font and the chapter's
% label font end in \MakeUppercase, which takes the title or label.
\documentclass{memoir}
\renewcommand\parttitlefont{\normalfont\huge\scshape\MakeUppercase}
\renewcommand\chaptitlefont{\normalfont\Large\itshape}
\renewcommand\chapnamefont{\normalfont\huge\bfseries\MakeUppercase}
\setsecheadstyle{\normalsize\itshape}
\setparaheadstyle{\normalsize\itshape}
\begin{document}
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{First}
Some text.
\section{A section}
More text.
\paragraph{A paragraph} Text after it.
\end{document}
